issue: Historical Worker mode/handoff quotes could overwrite newer owned saved/draft choices during an unrelated edit; the rejected choice could also survive in biography or an assistant question prefix.
fix: An older quote may recover missing metadata or preserve identical owned choices. A conflicting older quote is discarded; a current quoted change remains eligible for normal admission.
The effective draft mode set replaces the whole saved set. Its owned category, modes and handoff are revalidated against the current full catalog and carried into the next completed revision.
An obsolete historical declaration is distinct from a malformed or duplicate current declaration, which remains unresolved.
Untrusted full biography and assistant acknowledgement are withheld when a mode declaration is rejected/discarded; independently admitted name, service and calendar fields remain.
Explicit profile Save remains required. No additional provider call or automatic retry is introduced.

expectedFailures: saved REMOTE overwritten by stale BOTH
draft REMOTE overwritten by stale BOTH
newer handoff area overwritten by stale area
stale mode retained in biography/question prefix

tests.twoTurnCoverage: Both saved and draft regressions call the actual Worker handler twice; the second call uses the first completed taxonomy plan as revision-2 draft bindings alongside unchanged saved bindings. REMOTE remains REMOTE after a later name-only edit.
positiveBoundaries: Current explicit mode and handoff correction remains allowed
Historical quote for the same owned choices keeps current biography
Missing mode metadata can still recover from owned history
Archived category ID is never preserved

review.correctionFromEarlierReview: /root/r06_database found that simply rejecting the historical declaration omitted the draft hint and could revive saved BOTH on the next turn. The final candidate instead preserves revalidated current bindings and adds two-turn regression coverage.

reportedTests.note: Independent reviewer reran an overlapping wider handler suite; counts are not additive to the author's 194 tests.

confirmed: Saved/draft two-turn tests carry actual p_taxonomy_plan bindings into the new revision
Non-leaf identity, withdrawn REMOTE mode, duplicate catalog ID, conflicting exact alias and malformed modes never produce a plan
No production/test files changed by reviewer

continuityRetest.scope: Original two-turn reproduction independently repeated against the corrected candidate; current REMOTE/handoff remains in subsequent revision.

deploymentScope.required: uskoci-worker-interview only; deploy with its three modified source files
deploymentScope.reason: backgroundTaxonomyArchitect changes are confined to buildWorkerFullTreeTaxonomyProposals, called only by Worker. Need imports unchanged buildFullTreeTaxonomyProposals/helpers; geminiContextCache and singlePassTaxonomy import the unchanged formatter.

limitations: Actual Edge handler code runs with mocked provider, Auth and SQL HTTP boundaries; no live SQL completion is claimed by these tests.
Zero real Gemini/provider requests; exactly one mocked provider attempt per tested turn. No real latency, tokens or cost measurement and no speed claim.
No DEV or PROD deployment, Android test, GitHub CI or artifact verification was performed by this agent.
The guard validates provenance and current owned continuity, not arbitrary natural-language semantics. Explicit signed review/Save remains authoritative.
